Abstract.AbstractText: Under ambient conditions, CO2 was captured from atmosphere and reduced for sequestering CO2 into two {Dy2} single-molecule magnets through an in situ organic ligand reaction of hydrazine. A reasonable reaction mechanism is proposed, which provides a promising route towards the capturing and transforming CO2 into single-molecule magnets.
